dimension_note: Three cases per arm, because the sibling door's slice 0 measured that one case per arm makes a holdout meaningless. The negatives are the point of this corpus: five of six are near-misses of `architettura`, because the A/B collision is the most expensive failure available here — a boundary-LOCATING question answered from a reference that has no locator is the named failure mode of the Khononov acquisition (a third provenance on the boundary line). n01 and n02 are the two halves of that: where does the line go, and how granular. Symmetrically, t01 is `architettura`'s own negative n04 reused verbatim as a positive, so the seam is tested from both sides with the same sentence.
